messages:
Ben (Finance): Hey folks, InfraPulse renewal landed. Their new pricing mixes per-request, per-second and a mysterious "min-throughput" surcharge. Can someone sanity-check? Link: https://drive.redwood/vendor/infra/renewal (redacted)

Sofia (ML Ops): I looked briefly. They added a "hot-path" surcharge for sub-100ms responses and show a min throughput of 4,000 qps for our region. We never hit that.

Clara (Procurement): Hari from InfraPulse, is the 4,000 qps hard commit or a soft guidance? Also the quote includes a 3% "platform maintenance" line that wasn't in the PO last year.

Hari (InfraPulse): Hi team 90: the 4k qps is a committed minimum for our SLA tier. It only applies if you choose Enterprise SLA. The maintenance line covers cross-region replication and was added to Enterprise since last renewal. Happy to provide a non-Enterprise variant.

Ben (Finance): Can you provide unit math? We need per-month cost given our Jan-Mar actuals. We pay per-request normally; show delta if we switch to Enterprise or stick to per-request.

Sofia (ML Ops): Quick numbers from billing export: average qps peak = 1,200, 95th qps = 2,000, monthly requests ~ 360M.

AuditBot: Billing export link: /billing/exports/usage-2026-Q1.csv

Hari (InfraPulse): I'll prepare a 3-row pro-forma: (1) per-request only, (2) per-request + burst protection, (3) Enterprise commit (4k qps). Each will list per-request rate, monthly commit fee, and support credit.

Clara (Procurement): Also include an early-renewal incentive. If we sign for 12 months today, can we get a credit for the last invoice issue (INV-2026-0312) and a one-time onboarding credit?

Hari (InfraPulse): We can do a one-time $7k onboarding credit on 12-month sign, and 10% off commit fees for the first 3 months. I'll confirm on the invoice credit.

Ben (Finance): We need the math spelled out: e.g., "per-request: $0.0008/request -> monthly = 360M * 0.0008 = $288k". Include cost under 10% traffic growth scenario.

Sofia (ML Ops): Also show per-model split. Embeddings traffic tends to be chatty (many small requests). If per-request is expensive vs per-second for longer streams, that will change the decision.

Hari (InfraPulse): Understood. I'll include per-model projections and a 10% growth scenario. Expect CSV + short note in 6 hours.

Clara (Procurement): Legal asks: if we take Enterprise commit, can we opt down after 30 days if traffic is lower? Need a step-down clause.

Hari (InfraPulse): Step-downs are allowed once per term with 60-day notice and a 20% re-pricing penalty. I'll mark it in the quote but we can negotiate.

Ben (Finance): Also push for a cap on the hot-path surcharge and an explicit definition of "hot-path" (p95 < 100ms). We don't want surprises.

Sofia (ML Ops): FYI we'll run a quick estimator tonight comparing per-request vs commit for our March traffic. I'll paste results in this thread.

AuditBot: Reminder created: vendor-review-deadline 2026-04-12 09:00 PT

Clara (Procurement): Thanks Hari. When you post the CSV include a column for "assumed batching efficiency" because that affects per-request cost a lot.

Hari (InfraPulse): Will do. Also attaching the current SOW excerpt in the pro-forma for legal.

Ben (Finance): Great. If InfraPulse can waive INV-0312 and show clear commit math, procurement + finance can complete the approval flow faster.

Sofia (ML Ops): I'll run the estimator and upload by EOD.

Hari (InfraPulse): Sending the pro-forma now. Ping if anything missing.
